name: dsh-jev-verify
description: Jev (TypeSafe System One decision model) for DeepSeek Harness — five verdict tools: jev_decision (up to 25 typed questions, one parallel call, ~300 ms), jev_choose (rank 2-10 approaches), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (auto-guard audit), jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark, 96.3% measured). Plus an automatic tool-call guard (7 deterministic rules + Jev risk/loop backstop), system-prompt guidance so the agent actually calls it, and a GUI settings card. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one feature, never the profile.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/cases.js && node --check bench/bench.mjs && node --check lib/guard.js && node --check lib/dashboard.js && node --check client/client.js
